biggest_catch: The friend must deposit $750 within 30 days and keep the checking account open at least 6 months (early closure lets Vantage West debit the bonus back), so the $50 only sticks if the friend funds and holds the account - the referrer has no control over either.
catches: Friend must be a new member who has not been a primary member in the last 6 months.
Friend must open a new Essential Checking account, deposit $750 within 30 days of opening, and make one debit-card transaction within 60 days.
The Refer a Friend form must be submitted at account opening or within the first 60 days.
The friend's checking account must remain open at least 6 months; if closed earlier the bonus may be debited back.
Limit one offer per new primary member and account; cannot be combined with any other bonus offer associated with opening a checking account.
Employees and volunteers are not eligible.
The $50 bonus is subject to IRS reporting.

steps: Log in to Vantage West Online Banking or the Mobile App and submit the Refer a Friend form in the Form Center.
Friend opens a new Essential Checking account online or in branch (must be a new member, not a primary member in the last 6 months).
Friend deposits $750 or more within 30 days of account opening.
Friend makes one debit-card transaction within 60 days of account opening.
